announcements.label: Update needed
announcements.title: Update the launcher to keep sending feedback
body: The Feedback page has changed. Ideas, recomp proposals and messages are now sent from the launcher itself, and only snicolast reads them. GitHub Discussions is closing.
This version still sends them to GitHub Discussions, where they will no longer be read. Update the launcher when it offers it, or download the latest version.

announcements.label: Help wanted
announcements.title: Nico SWT now runs on Linux. Help port SR2 and TLW too
body: Nico SWT has a native Linux version, thanks to vojenfr, and it joins the macOS version made by Nutcasey. To try it, open Nico SWT and press Guide beside your system.
Nico SR2 and Nico TLW still run only on Windows. If you know some C++ and have a Mac or a Linux PC, you can help bring them over:
- Open a pull request on the game's repository straight away
- Or write on GitHub first, if you would rather talk it through
The Nico SWT ports are a good place to start, and every port is credited in the launcher.
